title: Standard bodies and a registry of well-known test methods

bodies.label: UN GHS / Manual of Tests and Criteria

note: method.standard is written `<body>:<designation>` in lower case; the body MUST be one of `bodies` (closed), the designation is the standard's own number and is open. `terms` is a non-exhaustive registry: a designation that is not listed is valid. `keys` lists the property keys the method is typically used for (informative, used by view rules that require a recognised method).
